status: NON_EXECUTABLE_POLICY_DESIGN_ONLY -- no provider calls, no code activation, no production mutation
purpose: Define the deterministic classification policy that routes each historical creator-funding relationship into one of five categories, using ONLY existing local evidence-quality signals and existing repository authority contracts. Calibration-dependent thresholds are left explicitly unresolved where B2Z-P2's live calibration has not yet completed.

p2_calibration_dependency.p2_status_at_time_of_writing: HOLD_B2Z_P2_CALIBRATION_FAILURE, then frozen overnight at READY_B2Z_P2_19_MEMBER_MANUAL_RESUME_GATE -- live calibration has NOT completed
p2_calibration_dependency.explicit_consequence: any threshold below that would ideally be calibrated against measured local-vs-raw agreement rates (e.g. 'temporal gap under N seconds implies M% confidence') is left as an EXPLICIT PLACEHOLDER bound by existing qualitative evidence (P1.6/P1.7's HIGH/LOW confidence classification) rather than a fabricated numeric threshold. This artifact will be revised once real P2 metrics exist.

LOCAL_EVIDENCE_SUFFICIENT_FOR_DISCOVERY.definition: relationship has SIGNATURE_BOUND_NORMALIZED_EVIDENCE (transfer_index or equivalent) with no disqualifying signal -- usable for Level-A candidate discovery / motif canonicalization without any RPC
criteria: a transfer_index (or tf_edges) row exists linking funder->creator with signature, amount, block_time
amount is not dust (existing SecondHopExpansionBuilder threshold: >= 0.01 SOL, from src/core/second_hop_builder.py MIN_UPSTREAM_SOL, reused here as the existing repository-defined dust floor)

no self-loop (source != the entity being funded, checked at both direct and upstream hops -- P1.7 found this is a REAL, not hypothetical, failure mode: 3/9 raw upstream candidates in the 20-member cohort were self-loops)
not flagged in infra_wallets (existing exclusion set, src/utils/infra_mapping.build_excluded_set())
LOCAL_EVIDENCE_SUFFICIENT_FOR_DISCOVERY.supports: EP4.0/4.1 motif canonicalization, candidate operational family surfacing (workstream 7)

LOCAL_EVIDENCE_SUFFICIENT_RAW_VERIFICATI.definition: relationship meets LOCAL_EVIDENCE_SUFFICIENT_FOR_DISCOVERY criteria AND has additional corroborating signal (small temporal gap to reference event, non-trivial amount, no documented extraction failure) making it a reasonable candidate for Level-B upgrade if the relationship becomes operationally important -- but discovery does not require the upgrade
criteria: temporal gap to reference event (migration_time or equivalent launch boundary) is QUALITATIVELY small -- P1.6 used <=3600 seconds as its HIGH-confidence threshold for the 20-member cohort; this artifact PRESERVES that exact threshold as the current best-available value rather than inventing a new one, but flags it explicitly as NOT YET CALIBRATED against a completed P2 run
the funding creator/entity has NO documented extraction failure (creator_funding_queue.status != 'failed')
the direct funder is NOT among the top fan-in/fan-out entities flagged for review (see SERVICE_DISTRIBUTION_REVIEW_REQUIRED below)
LOCAL_EVIDENCE_SUFFICIENT_RAW_VERIFICATI.rpc_required: optional -- desirable if the relationship is selected for canonical-attribution-adjacent use
LOCAL_EVIDENCE_SUFFICIENT_RAW_VERIFICATI.corresponds_to_p1_6_p1_7_finding: matches exactly the 10/20 'HIGH completeness_confidence, stage2_skip=true' members from B2Z-P1.6/P2's frozen prediction corpus

RAW_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED.definition: relationship has local evidence but it is AMBIGUOUS or LOW-CONFIDENCE by existing measured criteria -- raw verification is the only way to resolve it, not a preference
criteria_any_of: temporal gap to reference event exceeds the current 3600-second threshold (LOW confidence per P1.6)

documented extraction failure exists for this creator/entity (creator_funding_queue.status='failed') -- P1.6/P1.7 directly measured 3 such cases (ordinals 11, 15, 18) all failing for the IDENTICAL documented reason (90s worker timeout), proving genuinely incomplete local coverage rather than mere caution
multiple local candidate signatures exist for the same relationship with no clear single-best selection rule (existing B2Z contract's own candidates[0] rule is a discovery-time heuristic, not proof)

amount is at or near the dust floor (P1.7 found 3/5 raw upstream candidates in the cohort were exactly 1 lamport -- essentially certain to be spam/dust, not genuine funding, and MUST be flagged for verification or exclusion, never silently accepted)
self-loop detected (source == the entity being funded at either hop)
RAW_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED.note: this is the category that structurally CANNOT be resolved by adding more local data -- only an independent raw signal (or explicit human/interpretive review) can adjudicate it

MISSING_LOCAL_EVIDENCE.definition: no transfer_index (or equivalent signature-bound) row exists at all for this relationship
criteria: zero rows returned from the relational transfer_index search described in P1.7
MISSING_LOCAL_EVIDENCE.measured_scale_reference: at minimum the 63,343 tf_launches rows in EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE state (overnight_historical_coverage_profile.json population_6) fall unambiguously into this bucket

SERVICE_DISTRIBUTION_REVIEW_REQUIRED.definition: the funder or upstream entity itself is a high fan-out/fan-in address (bot, exchange-like, distribution hub) -- review metadata, does NOT gate acquisition or discovery, but flags the eventual relationship for human/downstream interpretive review before any operation-adjacent use
criteria_any_of: direct funder or upstream source exceeds the existing MAX_UPSTREAM_FUNDERS=50 threshold (src/core/second_hop_builder.py) when checked against funder_upstream_links -- confirmed at scale: the address AxiomRXZAq1... reaches 131 distinct funders, more than 2.6x the exclusion threshold
entity carries an existing creator_tags/creator_service_history behavioral tag (e.g. uses_axiom, uses_jitotip_other) indicating known bot/service activity
SERVICE_DISTRIBUTION_REVIEW_REQUIRED.rpc_required: not directly implied -- orthogonal to the RAW_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED axis; a relationship can be BOTH raw-verified AND still carry this review flag (matches B2Z-P1's existing FAN_OUT_REVIEW_ORDINALS design, which never gates acquisition)
SERVICE_DISTRIBUTION_REVIEW_REQUIRED.governance: review metadata only -- MUST NOT automatically reject, exclude, or promote to canonical attribution

classification_algorithm_pseudocode: 1. Does a transfer_index (or equivalent) signature-bound row exist for this relationship? NO -> MISSING_LOCAL_EVIDENCE, RPC required.
2. Is the source==destination (self-loop) at this hop? YES -> RAW_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED (cannot trust local evidence for this specific candidate).
3. Is the amount below the dust floor (0.01 SOL / existing MIN_UPSTREAM_SOL)? YES -> RAW_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED.
4. Does the funding entity have a documented extraction failure? YES -> RAW_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED.
5. Is the temporal gap to the reference event within the current 3600s threshold? NO -> RAW_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED. YES -> continue.

6. [Orthogonal check, always evaluated regardless of steps 1-5] Does the entity exceed the fan-out/fan-in threshold or carry a service/bot tag? YES -> add SERVICE_DISTRIBUTION_REVIEW_REQUIRED flag (non-gating).

7. If none of steps 1-5 triggered RAW_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED or MISSING: classify LOCAL_EVIDENCE_SUFFICIENT_RAW_VERIFICATION_OPTIONAL if all corroborating signals hold, else LOCAL_EVIDENCE_SUFFICIENT_FOR_DISCOVERY.
explicit_non_scoring_statement: No arbitrary numeric confidence score is introduced -- the repository's existing scoring contracts (e.g. src/core/second_hop_scorer.py's confidence_score, CONFIDENCE_STORE_MIN=15, CONFIDENCE_UI_FLOOR=35) are the ONLY existing scoring mechanism found, and they apply specifically to upstream_network_bridge cross-network scoring, not to a general per-relationship RPC-necessity score. This policy therefore uses BOOLEAN/CATEGORICAL criteria only (the six-step algorithm above), consistent with 'no arbitrary scoring if no existing scoring contract exists' per instruction.
authority_boundary: This policy classifies relationships for VERIFICATION PRIORITIZATION only. It grants no authority to acquire evidence, mutate operations, or promote candidates -- consistent with every prior B2Z/B2N milestone's CANDIDATE_EVIDENCE_ONLY posture.
next_step_when_p2_completes: re-derive the temporal-gap and amount thresholds from P2's actual measured creator/funder/amount/temporal agreement rates, replacing the currently-preserved P1.6 qualitative values with calibrated ones.
